question.text: A debt mutual fund scheme with Macaulay duration of the portfolio between 3 months and 6 months is classified as:

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI classification by Macaulay duration: Liquid (<91 days maturity), Ultra Short Duration (3-6 months), Low Duration (6-12 months), Short Duration (1-3 years), Medium Duration (3-4 years). The Trap: Liquid funds invest in securities with less than 91 days to maturity, which is slightly different from the 3-6 month Macaulay duration of Ultra Short Duration funds.
